text:
sam: quick heads-up 1 post-deploy synthetic heartbeat for /chat-heartbeat on canary (3% traffic) shows p99 jitter and a failing probe rate ~4%. holding ramp until we triage.

deploy-bot: deploy bot: rolling v4.1.0 -> v4.1.1 at 1769997600, canary 3%. smoke probes started 1769997650. recent probe failures: 9/230 in last 10m.

priya: fwiw this release enabled the new entropy-gating check in the probe runner (aimed at reducing noisy false positives). might be over-sensitive with current thresholds. no model or kernel changes.

sre-oncall: recommendation: gate the release hold. plan A: flip entropy_gating=false for canary and restart probes. Plan B: if we still see >1% failures after 12m, pin canary back to v4.1.0 and schedule rollback window.

sam: sounds good. priya can you toggle config for canary-only? prefer config change vs code rollback.

priya: applying canary override now via config-service. executing patch at 1769997790.
```
PATCH /internal/configs/overrides?scope=canary
{
  "features.entropy_gating": false
}
```
Propagation expected ~30-60s.

ci-bot: noted: pipeline commit d4c8b9f (release/v4.1.1) 1 no infra diffs. config-only override accepted (tx 9b1f).

deploy-bot: config change received, restarting synth runners 1769997820 -> collecting targeted heartbeat samples at 60/min.

qa-bot: focused synth started 1769997830, suite=heartbeat-short-window. baseline fail rate pre-patch ~4%.

sre-oncall: monitoring p95/p99, TLS errors, and probe entropy signals. threshold for resume: failures <1% and p99 < 1.5x baseline for sustained 12m.

qa-bot: 4m after override: failures dropped to 1.0% (3/300), p99 trending lower.

priya: good sign. looks like entropy check was tripping on legitimate minor jitter. we'll follow up with a threshold tune in next patch rather than re-enable.

sre-oncall: keep observation window. if it stays <1% for the remaining 8m we can remove hold and continue ramp to 25% with a monitoring window. else we pin back.

sam: i'm keeping the hold. product, heads-up so you can prep customer comms if we end up rolling back.

product: thanks, ping me if we end up pinning. i'll draft a short customer note mention "probe sensitivity adjustment" as root cause.

qa-bot: 12m mark: sustained failure rate 0.4% (5/1200), p99 within 1.1x baseline.

sre-oncall: metrics stable. releasing hold and resuming ramp to 25% at 1769998332. follow-up ticket created for entropy threshold tuning: ENG-PT-4821.

sam: thanks all. leaving this thread as the ops record: config override -> entropy gating disabled on canary -> synth verified -> hold released. will update release notes: "temporary probe sensitivity toggle during rollout; threshold fix planned."
